title: Invitations
intro: An invite code lets a player from outside the guild join it as a guest. A guest can sign up for calendar events but cannot see the roster, wishlists or loot history. Send them the link: they sign in with Battle.net and join the guild. You can remove them at any time.

create.title: New code
create.expiry_description: The code stays valid until the end of that day. Without a date, it never expires.
create.max_uses_description: How many players can join with this code.
create.created_description: Send this link to the player you want to invite.

codes.title: Active codes
codes.inactive_description: These codes can no longer be used to join the guild.
codes.empty: No active code. Generate one above to invite a player.

guests.title: Guests
guests.empty: No guests yet. Players who join with a code will show up here.

confirm.revoke_message: The code {{code}} can no longer be used. Guests who already used it stay in the guild.
confirm.delete_message: The code {{code}} will be removed from the list. Guests who used it stay in the guild.
confirm.remove_message: {{name}} will lose access to the guild and their characters will be detached. They will need a new code to come back.

notifications.error: The action failed. Try again in a moment.
